changelog:
one-shot-research-poster initial release.

- Build print-ready academic conference posters from papers, PDFs, LaTeX, arXiv/OpenReview/project pages, reference posters, and user assets in one user request.
- Guarantees a complete, high-quality poster package: editable poster source, print PDF, PNG preview, local assets, validation report, and claim-evidence audit.
- Defaults to a hard-gated posterly-style production pipeline; uses interactive editors only as optional layout assistants.
- Automatically verifies claims, figures, data sources, conference and affiliation logos, and follows official venue logistics.
- Ensures no browser screenshots or incomplete artifacts; posters must meet all listed production and audit checks or report missing gates.
summary: Create print-ready academic posters from papers or project pages in one request, producing editable source, final PDF/PNG, local assets, logos, QR codes, and...
